Equipment:
 Carrier Air Conditioning Outdoor Units

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title 
block. "There are 3 units of air conditioner"
Its function is to keep the required temperature of control room.

The first draft was initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber, tested by eng. Kamal Hassan, 
accepted by eng. Abd El-Ghaffar Osman: general director, and approved by eng. Ahmed 
Mohamed Yonis; Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1 & 2 Power Station
and certified by eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman HPGC 
inspection and quality control general director.
A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category,

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category,

The maintenance staff should be well 
 trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Stop the unit and turn off the 
 electric supply.
Special mechanical tool kit
Vacuum pump

Cleaning articles ( fluid, rags, 
 ... etc )
Charging hose

Clean the unit ( suction and 
 exhaust ducts , condenser, evaporator ) with compressed air

Inspect the evaporator fan, 
 condenser fan.
Inspect the pipe connections.

Turn 
 on the electric supply and operate the unit

Inspect the coolant water pumps 
 and making maintenance for them.

Inspect and cleaning for all fan 
 cool units in the site.

Drain 
 the water from compensation water tank of the system and cleaning it and 
 paint with a suitable paint.
Refill the tank with water again.
Measure the pressure from gauge points.
Refill with refrigerant 22 if necessary.
Finish the work permit.
